dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: Oh, there are a few places to verify over here too... All of them are hidden paths that can't be seen by just looking at the shape of the mountains...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Hmm, it's tiring work, but verifying and updating maps is extremely important to people who rely on them to travel.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: And it'll help them identify potentially dangerous areas, so they can plan ahead and avoid them.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: As expected, the deserted areas which had to be surveyed seem to have been occupied by various monsters and fungi...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Of course, the more people we have, the better. It's not just because places with difficult terrain are inherently dangerous, but we may even run into all sorts of strange monsters...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: N-Next time, I should ask Lan to send a few more people.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: That's such a relief! But do let me know if you encounter any trouble, and I'll mark it on the map...
